title: Cremation of Mungo Lady at Lake Mungo
summary: About 42,000 years ago a woman, known as Mungo Lady or Mungo Woman, was cremated at Lake Mungo in the Willandra Lakes region of New South Wales, and her remains were buried in a small pit. It is described as the world's oldest known cremation. Mungo Man, found in 1974, is a separate burial.

uncertainty.note: Sources say "at least 42,000" (NSW government) and "some 42,000 years ago" (The Conversation); a National Museum of Australia range of 40,000-42,000 was seen only in search results. Years are 1950 minus the age; plus 2,000 years is a placeholder width.
